senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.30.24;
the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel
father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies
a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah

strongs.def: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
strongs.from: future of H3254 (יָסַף); let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding)
